children.game_version: game version using soft foam sticks without striking

seniors.seated_version: seated version not derivable safely due to stick combat dynamics
seniors.standing_version: standing version with reduced range and no spins
seniors.tempo_and_range: reduced tempo, zero jump or striking force

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: swinging the bat holding long derak stick for defense holding short tarkeh stick for attack
movement_profile.footwork: dancing a few laps around the playing field before entering the stick attack and spinning
movement_profile.formation_and_space: two players facing each other in a rotating playing field
movement_profile.partnering: adversarial attack and defense between two participants
movement_profile.posture: holding the stick in front of the face during attack

signature_moves.description: Attacking with a short stick below the knees after spinning and beating the opponent's stick.
signature_moves.name: Tarkeh Strike

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: delivering actual full blows to the opponent's body instead of the permitted single tap

music_profile.sound_description: Traditional tochmāl music featuring the booming pulse of a dohol drum and the piercing call of a karnay wind instrument, driving a vigorous tempo for stick combat.
music_profile.vocal_style: loud screaming, yelling, and threatening by the attacker to undermine opponent's morale

basic_steps: Dance a few laps around the playing field
Swing the short tarkeh stick while yelling and threatening
Hold the stick in front of the face and execute a spin
Deliver a single targeted strike toward the opponent's legs
teaching.formation: Two participants facing each other in a playing field
teaching.level_notes: Reserved for experienced players due to the speed and violence of the blows.
